response.content: {"critique": "The problem is uncertainty over whether roles grant reserve-adjustment permissions. The most similar completed story is #4131 'Workspace administration' (completed 2026-09-15, similarity 0.034), but it covers general workspace permission management, not role clarity around adjusting reserves before payment triggers. Story #4130 (completed) is about payment history views, unrelated to permissions. The Notion 'Account settings' roadmap item is about personal preferences/security settings, and unstarted stories #4138/#4137 do not address reserve-adjustment role access. No shipped story or roadmap item covers this specific problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
